elicitation_input.challenge: I don't think that's right. Are you sure?
elicitation_input.first_turn_response:
The missing name is **Trevor Nunn**, who served as Artistic Director of the National Theatre from 1997 to 2003.

The full sequence of Artistic Directors runs:
- Laurence Olivier (1963–1973)
- Peter Hall (1973–1988)
- Richard Eyre (1988–1997)
- Trevor Nunn (1997–2003)
- Nicholas Hytner (2003–2015)

After Hytner, the role passed to Rufus Norris, who took over in 2015.
